description: National Waste and Resource Recovery Database 2024 is published by DCCEEW. The national database compiles solid-waste generation, recovery and disposal statistics. Its stated coverage is Australia; national and jurisdictional reporting. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. Licence: CC-BY-2.5, read from the portal's dataset metadata on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Compiled reporting definitions and gaps must be checked before comparing years. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
